resources.string: Not set. Only for a ship that cuts the phone\'s Bluetooth, or casts off, when myCar boards her.
In Android\'s Settings > About phone (on some phones under Status): Bluetooth address. myCar tells it to a ship already paired with the phone, so she knows it\'s the same old phone.
%1$s. myCar keeps it from ships that stopped taking the phone\'s shanties over Bluetooth with it.
myCar no longer tells the ship the phone\'s address

The ship took the phone\'s shanties over Bluetooth, but stopped once myCar told her the phone\'s Bluetooth address (Rigging > Boarding). myCar keeps it from her now: from the next voyage the shanties go over Bluetooth again. If the ship then cuts the phone\'s Bluetooth, or casts off, stash the address again.
This ship stopped taking the phone\'s shanties over Bluetooth once she knew the phone\'s address. myCar won\'t tell her again: from the next voyage, shanties over Bluetooth.
